objective: Implement effective training and demonstrate measured improvement through live sparring experiments

requirements.requirement: Explore multiple training methods and diagnose failures
Actually train model on separated real duel data
requirements.method: Action-balanced behavior cloning with frozen parent KL coefficient 0.5

requirements.requirement: Load and run learned model in live client duels
Demonstrate live improvement without evaluation data leakage
End scheduled games and preserve evidence
requirements.tests: 44 passed: live demonstrations, demonstration split, training league

scope_limits: Improvement demonstrated against five fixed tactical teachers; human and unseen-opponent strength not established.
Potion style score fell by 0.05, within prespecified tolerance of 0.10.
